market_composition_finding: IMPORTANT, not previously expected: none of the 4 valid competitors are confirmed Israeli/Hebrew-market despite every search being run in Hebrew (per ANALYZER_V3_SPEC.md's own warning that a Hebrew query can still surface non-Israeli accounts). Captions: 3 in English (@yeuunnt.22, @unboxingexpert, @digitalnexus1), 1 in Spanish (@toptech.mx). This benchmark should be read as an EXPANDED/GLOBAL-MARKET benchmark, not an Israeli-market one -- per the spec's own expansion rule ('if insufficient in-market data exists, expand gradually while recording the market source'), which is exactly what happened here, not a methodology failure, but it must be stated plainly rather than assumed away.

required_output_statements: Our opening motion magnitude is at the 0th percentile of this 4-competitor benchmark -- below every single benchmarked competitor, not just below average.
All 4 benchmarked competitors show organic human/object motion; our opening uses a simulated crop-pan on a static image.
All 4 benchmarked competitors show real human presence and real product-in-use demonstration; our opening shows neither.

All 4 benchmarked competitors read as native/authentic content; our opening reads as catalog/marketplace material (corroborating Layer 3's cause (c) finding with a 4-competitor benchmark, not a single anecdote).
None of the 4 benchmarked competitors show a detected hard cut in their opening -- cut/editing frequency is not the differentiator; sustained motion intensity is.
